4) Post-signature evidence: we will produce a single evidentiary bundle (PDF) with the signed doc, signer authority form, and DocuSign certificate of completion. Confirm where you'd like us to deliver it (S3 link for legal ops / secure file share / your internal repository). We plan to retain the bundle for 7 years per our retention policy unless you need a different duration.

Attachments: MSA_Amendment_v3_redlines.pdf (redline), Signer_Authority_Form.pdf (fillable).

Target: send envelope on Friday 11/13 if we have confirmations above — that gives us time for any notarization step.

If helpful, I can run a 15-min dry run with your Legal Ops and our Contracts Ops to walk the lane and verify the DocuSign TTL and witness fields.
